title: Forge Project Config
description: Per-repository .forge/config.yaml. The engine-vs-project seam: the forge-run workflow and its phase agents read this at runtime. Project-agnostic.

base_branch.description: Default branch PRs target and feature branches are cut from.

integration_branch.description: Opt-in. The one branch forge is allowed to MERGE into (for example forge/integration). With it set, integrate merges each verified task branch here and keeps a single open PR from it into the base, so overnight tasks compound on one branch and conflicts are resolved somewhere disposable. Omit it and forge never merges anything, which is the default. It must not appear in protected_branches; the guardrail refuses the merge if it does.

protected_branches.description: Single source of truth for the git guardrail's protected list. The hook reads this (relative to cwd) before falling back to FORGE_PROTECTED_BRANCHES or its built-in default.

profile.description: Default pipeline shape for tasks in this repo that do not set their own `profile`. 'fast' trims intake and small-diff review; 'standard' is the full pipeline; 'audit' is the read-only investigation path.

review_threshold_lines.description: Fast profile only: review is skipped when the branch diff changes fewer than this many lines. A diff at or above the threshold still gets the full review phase. Ignored by the standard and audit profiles.

vcs.description: Version control host and CLI used for PRs/MRs.

cli.description: CLI used by the integrate phase. Default derived from host (github->gh, gitlab->glab).

pr_target.description: Base/target branch for PRs (GitHub) or MRs (GitLab).

commands.description: How forge builds and checks THIS repo. Phase agents shell these out. Empty string means the phase skips that step.

test.description: Test command. Verify runs this. Required key; should be non-empty for any repo with code-changing tasks.

autonomy.description: Pipeline autonomy: the default tier and which task types must pause for plan approval.

default_tier.description: 0 read-only | 1 branch+PR | 2 gated (plan approval). Applied when a task spec does not set its own autonomy_tier.

require_gate.description: Task types forced to tier-2 plan approval regardless of their own tier. Such tasks park at plan_gate until /forge:approve.

surfaces.description: The areas of this system a task spec may declare as its `surface` (for example [schema, auth, api, ui-shell, profile, products]). Declaring the list turns a typo'd surface into a run-time error instead of a task that silently runs alone in its own group. Omit to allow any surface string.

review_lenses.description: Optional. When set, the review phase fans out one parallel reviewer per lens (e.g. correctness, security, tests, scope) and a synth pass consolidates their findings. Omit for a single review agent.

budget.description: Pipeline budget: retry cap and per-phase model selection.

max_attempts.description: Attempts per task across the combined verify->build and review->build recovery loops; once exhausted the task parks blocked.

models.description: Phase -> model. Overrides the model the phase agent runs on; omit to inherit the session model.

modelRef.description: A Claude Code model alias or a pinned full model name. Aliases verified from official docs: default, best, opus, sonnet, haiku, opusplan, opus[1m], sonnet[1m]. Full strings like claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (optional [1m] suffix on opus/sonnet).
